subject: Science
stem: An Amoeba is made up of just a single cell that performs all life functions on its own, whereas a human being is made up of trillions of cells organised into tissues and organs. Based on this, Amoeba is classified as:
explanation: Unicellular organisms (like Amoeba, bacteria) consist of a single cell performing all necessary life functions — multicellular organisms (like humans, plants) have many specialised cells organised into tissues, organs, and systems.

subject: Science
stem: Animals such as earthworms, insects, and jellyfish, which lack an internal bony skeleton or backbone, are classified as:
explanation: Invertebrates lack a vertebral column (backbone) — the vast majority of animal species fall into this group (insects, worms, molluscs) — vertebrates (fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, mammals) all possess an internal backbone.
